title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.01461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. translated_title: NextMe-800：从数月的第一视角视频预测个人行为
translated_abstract: 我们常常雄心勃勃地制定计划，却习惯性地行动，事后回想时会不禁思考：如果当初知道自己实际上会做什么，是否会制定不同的计划？后见之明为审视过去的决策提供了宝贵的视角，尽管我们常常希望在做出选择的那一刻就能模拟这种后见之明。如果一个系统能够根据个人历史生成合理的未来行为轨迹，这样的预览可能帮助人们制定更切合实际的计划、做出更明智的决策。我们提出了NextMe-800，这是一个约800小时的第一视角数据集，由一名志愿者在126天内采集，包含1 Hz频率的图像、注视和音频，并在从原子动作到重大活动的五个层级抽象层次上进行了文本标注。我们将个性化动作预测形式化为开放词汇的K步序列预测问题，并构建了NextAct——一个结合NextMe-800与多人EgoLife数据集的1500点基准测试。我们使用基于嵌入的软编辑距离作为（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了约800小时、历时126天的第一视角多模态数据集NextMe-800（含图像、注视、音频及五级抽象层次标注），并构建1500点基准NextAct，将个性化行为预测形式化为开放词汇的K步序列预测任务，旨在通过预览未来行为帮助人们做出更明智的决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour egocentric multimodal dataset collected over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio annotated at five hierarchical abstraction levels, and presents the 1,500-point NextAct benchmark that formulates personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction to help people make better-informed decisions by previewing plausible future behaviors.
